description: Taking over the District General Hospital - Horana under the Line Ministry of Health and Mass Media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Horana Hospital, which functioned as a base hospital, was upgraded to the level of a District General Hospital on 2022-06-03 and is currently administered under the Western Provincial Council. At present, the hospital has a total bed capacity of 544 and an approved cadre of 739. The hospital, which is centrally located covering the Horana area and its surrounding areas of Kalutara, Colombo and Ratnapura Districts, provides healthcare services to a population of approximately one million. In view of the need to increase the relevant facilities and human resources to provide tertiary care services as a District General Hospital, it has been identified as appropriate to take over the said hospital under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media. The concurrence of the Hon. Governor of the Western Province has been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to take over the District General Hospital - Horana, including all physical and financial assets, under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, was approved by the Cabinet.
